{{Quote|We've established a perimeter around the governor's tower.|[[Boil]], to [[Obi-Wan Kenobi]]|<ref name="Kidnapped" />}}
The '''governor's tower''' in the [[Artisan colony/Legends|Artisan colony]] served as the headquarters of [[Governor/Legends|Governor]] [[Roshti/Legends|Roshti]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. [[21 BBY/Legends|Some time]] during the war the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] [[Battle of Kiros|invaded]] [[Kiros/Legends|Kiros]] and this tower became the headquarters of Separatist [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Darts D'Nar/Legends|Darts D'Nar]].

{{Struct-stub}}

==History==
When the forces of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] arrived to stop the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] takeover, the tower was the location of the negotiations between [[Darts D'Nar/Legends|Darts D'Nar]] and [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]]. D'Nar forced Kenobi to surrender with the threat of [[Thermal annihilator bomb/Legends|bombs]] around the [[Artisan colony/Legends|city]]. Kenobi tricked D'Nar into fighting him in hand-to-hand combat, according to [[Zygerrian/Legends|Zygerrian]] tradition, until the bombs were disabled, at which point Kenobi tried to force D'Nar to surrender. D'Nar, however, set off an explosive in his [[Unidentified T-series tactical droid (Kiros)/Legends|tactical droid]], who Kenobi [[Telekinesis/Legends|Force pushed]] out of the window. D'Nar escaped while Kenobi was distracted, but he was captured before he could leave the planet.
[[File:Separatist_Headquarters_Kiros.jpg|thumb|right|200px|The tower as depicted in the ''Slaves of the Republic'' comic books]]
==Behind the scenes==
The structure of the tower is in the shape of a [[Togruta/Legends|Togruta]] head.
